column1: IntraBandCC-CombinationIndicates the state of the carriers and BWPs indexes of the carriers in a CC combination, each carrier in this combination corresponds to an entry in servCellIndexList with same order. This IE shall have the same size as servCellIndexList.
IntraBandCC-CombinationReqListIndicates the list of the requested carriers/BWPs combinations for an intra-band CA component.
servCellIndexListindicates the list of cell index for an intra-band CA component.
